title: feat: save exportScale in AppState
body:
This PR ensures that the scale parameter is saved in AppState when you update it.

![Screenshot 2021-05-14 at 18 32 36](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/254647/118307562-c4112a80-b4e2-11eb-865a-008dc15d05e9.png)

This is another baby-step along the way towards https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/2261 , but it's a slightly bigger baby-step than my previous PR.


Possible gotchas:

* defaultExportScale is calculated based on the browser's devicePixelRatio, and there are a few places which previously used the hardcoded default scale = 1, but will now be using defaultExportScale, which might be 2 on a retina screen.
* ~should I be putting EXPORT_SCALES and defaultExportScale in constants.ts? EXPORT_SCALES I think probably yes, but I'm not sure about defaultExportScale. Thoughts?~ I have put EXPORT_SCALES in constants.ts.
* ~I also realised that exportPadding is never set anywhere, so I removed it. This might be a half-finished job, so I will check on Monday and either finish the job or back it out into its own PR if it's too much faff.~ turns out exportPadding is exposed to the public api in packages/, so I guess it has to stay. I created a DEFAULT_EXPORT_PADDING constant though.
* In one place, I am handed elements as ExcalidrawElement and I need NonDeletedExcalidrawElement, so I call the function to filter them. Hopefully this isn't too expensive.
